name: io.github.mindstone/mcp-server-servicenow
title: ServiceNow
description: ServiceNow ITSM MCP server for Model Context Protocol hosts

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: ServiceNow instance name (e.g. acme for acme.service-now.com)

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID (optional; alternative to username/password when the instance enforces MFA/SSO — requires an OAuth application registry entry with the client credentials grant enabled)

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret (optional; used with SERVICENOW_CLIENT_ID instead of username/password)
